messages:
emily: Pushing the near-final launch post draft into the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/5-launch-final. Please do quick passes on claims, webinar CTA, and lead routing.
dan: quick skim looks great. the hero mentions "~2x median latency reduction" 7 can you add the bench command and env so legal/product can verify?
olga: legal here. need test harness, date, and a short disclaimer that it's an internal run. avoid absolutes like "always" or "guaranteed".
emily: added bench under Methods: 
```
./bench_runner --model rwd-7b-q4 --baseline open-7b --seq 128 --batch 8 --hw g5x --runs 100 --seed 99
```
results: median 46ms vs 95ms (2.06x). run date: 2026-03-31.
harry: for tracking/routing: include hidden fields: `product_interest=redwood_inference`, `lead_source=launch_blog_v3`. UTM for CTA: 
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=q2_launch&utm_content=demo_cta&lead_source=launch_blog_v3
```
Route first 72h to sales queue `launch-priority`, then to `launch-nurture`. Region routing: NA->na-sales, EU->eu-sales, APAC->apac-sales.
ops-bot: noted: routing rules set for HubSpot form integration. early-access gating enabled for first 72 hours.
olga: legal quick-pass 2705: approved with footnote: "Internal benchmark performed 2026-03-31; results may vary based on workload and configuration." Removed any superlative language.
emily: updated hero subhead per feedback and added the legal footnote. CTA: "Join our live demo for an in-depth benchmark walkthrough and Q&A. Register (early-access priority): <link>"
publish-bot: scheduled publish: 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z. embargo: true. will notify #press and #social on release.
emily: locking the doc for edits. thanks all for quick passes!
